Premium-voucher project cost 46,909,200 yen and reports 100% sales and over 98% redemption. PCR screening project cost 7,002,400 yen with recurring tests covering approximately 95% of about 260 staff in 16 facilities. COVID grant-funded projects only. 確認範囲：Supported Web extracted text sampled; not a complete locally archived full-text review.
